# Git Branching Specialist Skill

> **Category:** Tech Skills > Others > Git

## Overview

Implements Git branching strategies including GitFlow, trunk-based development, and release branching for team collaboration

## Quick Start

1. Copy this skill folder to your workspace under `.github/skills/`
2. Reference in agent files: `skills: [git-branching-specialist-skill]`
3. The skill activates automatically when the agent is invoked

## Structure

```text
git-branching-specialist-skill/
  SKILL.md    # Skill definition with procedures and standards
  GUIDE.md    # This guide
```

## Companion Agent

This skill is designed to work with the `@git-branching-specialist` agent from the Independent Agents catalogue.

## Key Capabilities

- Design GitFlow branching strategy
- Implement trunk-based development workflow
- Configure branch protection rules
- Manage release and hotfix branches

## Technology Standards Applied

- **GitFlow**: GitFlow branching model
- **Trunk-Based**: Trunk-based development practices
- **Branch Protection**: Branch protection and review requirements
